extras: The author notes that resolving conflicts with other date plugins is technically challenging without merging the code.
intentEvidence: Removes time from datetime properties when the time is 00:00:00.
motivation: The author integrated this functionality to resolve conflicts with other date plugins while developing a separate Title Date Changer plugin.
problem: Datetime properties often retain a 00:00:00 time component even when only a date is intended.
summary: A utility that removes the time component from datetime properties when the time is exactly 00:00:00, and includes a title date changer feature.
